Perfect Little Cafe
Jul 2017 • Couples
Me and my fiancé have been to this place twice as we loved it so much. We've been to a few cafes and restaurants around the area but this is our favourite so far. We first came just for a drink, I had an ice cream coffee and my partner had the Mango/Banana Smoothie and a Cappuccino. All were perfect and delicious, coffee was hot and the smoothie thick and tasty. 

The second time we went, we went for dinner. We shared a Chicken Salad and the Milanese Chicken with Ratatouille. The Milanese Chicken was crispy and tasty and came with some rice, dip and the ratatouille. The Salad was basic but tasted great and had a nice dressing. 

This place was very well priced and has an amazing atmosphere. That's what makes this place special. It's family run and they are lovely! Minh, the owners Son speaks perfect English and is polite, courteous and friendly. The kitchen faces the tables so you can see them working hard and smell the lovely food being cooked. The place has only been open since April and it's definitely somewhere you should visit. When we went they also had two gorgeous kittens called Sam & Ginger 😊
